title: The Trusted Spirit of Revelation
intro: In the unseen realms, a being of pure light moves with precision, executing every command without hesitation. This figure has spoken to chosen servants, brought words of guidance, and witnessed the unfolding of divine decrees across the ages. Who is this honored soul?
clues: I am a being of pure light, created from light, and I have never disobeyed a single command of my Lord.
I move between the heavens and the earth, descending with the decrees of the Most Merciful.
I was sent to a noble virgin in the sanctuary, announcing to her a pure son.
I am the spirit of holiness, and I supported a prophet who was given clear signs and the Gospel.
I came to a cave on a mountain to deliver the first words of a recitation that would be preserved forever.
I am the trustworthy spirit, and it was I who brought the Quran down upon the heart of the final messenger.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Harut (one of the two angels in Babylon)

trial.label: Key Mission/Role
options: Blowing the trumpet on the Day of Judgment

outcome.label: Outcome of the Mission
options: The Quran was revealed to Prophet Muhammad
The trumpet was blown on the Day of Judgment
Hell was guarded and its gates were closed
The Book of Deeds was presented to Allah
The rain was sent down to the earth
outcome.answer: The Quran was revealed to Prophet Muhammad

verse: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel] (81:19)
